body:
## Context
Issue #592: `packages/cli/lib/mcp-server.mjs` accepts `process.env.ADLC_CLI_BIN` without checking that it is an absolute path to an existing regular file, and documents it nowhere in `packages/cli/README.md` or `packages/cli/lib/help.mjs`.
Issue #875: `packages/cli/lib/registry.mjs` and `packages/cli/lib/dispatch.mjs` invoke `npx adversarial-review` with no version range constraint, pulling an unpinned `@latest` from the registry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `packages/cli/lib/mcp-server.mjs` validates `ADLC_CLI_BIN` when set: requires a non-empty, control-char-free absolute path (`isAbsolute`) that resolves (`statSync`) to an existing regular file (`isFile()`), throwing `invalid(...)` (`-32602`) otherwise.
- `packages/cli/README.md` and `packages/cli/lib/help.mjs` document `ADLC_CLI_BIN` as an operator-only entrypoint override seam.
- `packages/cli/lib/registry.mjs` declares `packageSpec: 'adversarial-review@^2.6.0'` on the `review` tool entry, and `packages/cli/lib/dispatch.mjs` passes `tool.packageSpec ?? tool.packageName` to `npx` (while keeping `tool.packageName` as `'adversarial-review'` for labels and diagnostics).

## Verification
`node --test packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs`
title: cli: validate ADLC_CLI_BIN in mcp-server and pin adversarial-review version range (#592, #875)
